note: How each reward is availed. Rules match a reward by name (first match wins). Used by the dashboard, the redemption sheet script, the leadership report and docs/redemption_operations.md.

physical.label: Shipped to you
how: Enter your delivery address when you claim
Masai orders and ships it
You get the tracking details by email and WhatsApp
physical.subject_to: Delivery in India only, within about 21 working days. Stock and vendor availability apply.
physical.if_not_delivered: If we cannot supply it, your Miles are returned or you can pick another reward.

reimburse.label: Pay and get reimbursed
how: Buy it yourself from the official site
Upload the invoice within 7 days of claiming
Masai verifies and reimburses you within 10 working days
reimburse.subject_to: Reimbursed up to the reward value. The invoice must be in your name and dated after you claimed. Anything above the reward value is on you.
reimburse.if_not_delivered: If no valid invoice is received within 30 days the claim lapses and your Miles are returned.

voucher.label: Code or voucher
how: Masai purchases the voucher
The code is emailed to you within 5 working days
voucher.subject_to: Vouchers are subject to the issuer's own terms and expiry.
voucher.if_not_delivered: If we cannot issue it, your Miles are returned.

session.label: Scheduled with the team
how: The team contacts you to agree a time
You attend the session
The claim is closed once it has happened
session.subject_to: Depends on the availability of the mentor or expert. We aim to schedule within 15 working days.
session.if_not_delivered: If it cannot be scheduled within 30 days, your Miles are returned.

event.label: Subject to the event
how: Your claim is recorded and held
Masai confirms your place once the event is scheduled
You are told the date, format and what to bring
event.subject_to: The event must actually take place, and seats or slots are limited. Placement-linked items also depend on placement eligibility and employer availability, and are not a job guarantee.
event.if_not_delivered: If the event does not take place within 90 days, your Miles are returned or carried over, at your choice.

discount.label: Applied to your fee
how: Claim the reward
The team confirms your enrolment
The discount is applied to your Campus Immersion fee invoice
discount.subject_to: One-time, non-transferable, valid for the next Campus Immersion you register for.
discount.if_not_delivered: If you do not register in the validity window, your Miles are returned.

recognition.label: Recognition
how: The team confirms what will be published
You approve the content
It goes live within 7 working days
recognition.subject_to: Published only with your consent. Wording is reviewed by Masai.
recognition.if_not_delivered: If it cannot be published, your Miles are returned.
